target_audience: Owners/managers of Spanish medical centers (40-65 years old), professional, trust-oriented, requiring high compliance (DGT, RGPD).

headings.usage: Use for all main headings (H1, H2, H3). It establishes immediate trust and traditional authority suitable for medical/legal contexts.

body.usage: Use for all body text, feature descriptions, and UI elements. Provides high legibility and a modern 'software' feel to contrast the classic headings.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white

surfaces.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0f172a]/70 border-b border-white/10 (Use for sticky nav and overlays)
surfaces.neumorphism_crisp: bg-[#0f172a] border border-white/5 shadow-2xl shadow-black/50 (Use for Pricing cards)
surfaces.bento_cards: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0f172a] to-[#0a0f1a] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl hover:border-gold-500/30 transition-colors duration-300

textures.noise: Subtle SVG noise overlay over the hero background to reduce digital flatness and add a premium matte feel.

glows.ambient: Use radial gradients in the background (e.g., a very soft, massive 1000px radial blur of #f5b301 at 5% opacity behind the hero section).

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Generous (p-8 to p-16 for internal card padding, py-24 to py-32 for section spacing).
grids_and_layouts.hero: Two-column asymmetric on desktop. Left: Text content (60%). Right: Abstract dashboard/software visual (40%).
grids_and_layouts.features_bento: CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3). Feature cards should span different rows/cols to avoid a boring uniform grid. Example: The 'DGT CSV import' feature should span 2 columns.
grids_and_layouts.pricing: 3-column CSS grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3). Middle card (Standard) scaled up by 1.05 with a gold border and 'Most Popular' badge.

motion.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion for smooth, subtle fade-up transitions on scroll (y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1, duration: 0.6s, ease: 'easeOut').
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase border opacity.
motion.pricing_toggle: Smooth layout animation using Framer Motion's layoutId for the monthly/annual toggle pill.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the dark navy background meets APCA/WCAG AAA standards. Use text-slate-300 for body text to reduce eye strain against pure black.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap all framer-motion animations in a check for prefers-reduced-motion.

hero_abstract.description: Sleek futuristic digital interface, use on the right side of the hero section as an abstract representation of the software.

doctor_trust.description: Doctor writing on a chart, use in the testimonials or about section to reinforce the professional medical target audience.

driving_license_context.description: Person holding an ID card, use near the DGT feature block.

media.icon_strategy: Use 'lucide-react'. Use gold (#f5b301) or green (#22c55e) for icon colors depending on the context (green for compliance/security, gold for premium features). Do NOT use emojis.

copy_suggestions.hero_tagline: El programa especializado para centros de reconocimientos de carnet de conducir y certificados médicos

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app (LandingPage.js) using the established Tailwind configuration.
Inject IBM Plex Sans via Google Fonts in the HTML/CSS, and use standard Georgia for headings.
Create a sticky Navigation bar with crystal glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0a0f1a]/80`).
Build the Hero section with the 'hero_abstract' image subtly fading into the dark background.
Build a Features section using a Bento grid layout (asymmetric sizes). Cover the 9 features provided in the prompt.
Build a Pricing section with a Monthly/Annual toggle (use Framer Motion for the toggle animation). Show Trial, Standard (highlighted), and Premium tiers.
Build an FAQ section using Shadcn UI Accordion.
Build a Footer with legal links.
Do not use generic 'Vercel' black/white aesthetics. Stick strictly to the Navy/Gold/Green palette.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where content scrolls underneath.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped, slight gradient or sharp interactions).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing image categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
